mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_insights (user_id, insight_type, insight_key, insight_value, confidence, source, expires_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{insightType}, #{insightKey}, #{insightValue}, #{confidence}, #{source}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_insights SET insight_type = #{insightType}, insight_key = #{insightKey}, insight_value = #{insightValue}, confidence = #{confidence}, source = #{source}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user_insights WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC
SELECT * FROM user_insights WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > #{now}) ORDER BY updated_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_insights (user_id, insight_type, insight_key, insight_value, confidence, source, expires_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{insight.insightType}, #{insightKey}, #{insight.insightValue}, #{insight.confidence}, #{insight.source}, #{insight.expiresAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE insight_type = #{insight.insightType}, insight_value = #{insight.insightValue}, confidence = #{insight.confidence}, source = #{insight.source}, expires_at = #{insight.expiresAt}, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_insights WHERE expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at < #{now}
